# Solvigos — Customer Support Outsourcing for Small Businesses

> Deliver exceptional customer experiences without the cost and complexity of building an in-house support department.

## About
Solvigos provides omnichannel customer support, technical support, BPO & back-office operations, and CRM & AI chatbot setup for growing businesses. 10+ years in operation, 200+ clients served.

## Core Services
- Customer Support: Omnichannel support (chat, email, phone, social media), 24/7 coverage, dedicated teams
- Technical Support: Tier 1 & Tier 2 support, product-trained agents, SLA-driven workflows
- BPO & Back-Office: Data entry, order processing, CRM management, workflow automation
- CRM & AI Chatbot Setup: Implementation, configuration, integration, and AI chatbot deployment

## Key Features
- Dedicated support teams (not shared pools)
- Month-to-month agreements, no long-term contracts
- 24/7 coverage across all time zones
- Fast onboarding (2-3 weeks)
- Real-time reporting and analytics
- 97% client satisfaction rate

## Pricing
Starter (1 agent), Growth (up to 5 agents, most popular), Enterprise (15+ agents), Custom plans available.
